Local & independent

A Hilton-based crew that just really hates dirty bins.

Immaculate Bins is run by Jeremy and his wife, lifelong Hilton residents who started the business right in their own neighborhood after noticing nobody nearby offered it. It grew block by block into a full Monroe County route.

Our standard

Hot water, not a hose

Anything less than high heat and real pressure just moves the grime around. Our equipment is built specifically for bin sanitizing — not a rented pressure washer from the hardware store.

Our responsibility

Wastewater, handled right

Dumping bin runoff into a storm drain is against code in most municipalities — and it’s exactly what a hose-and-broom job does. We contain and dispose of every gallon properly.

Our approach

Curb-side, low-effort

You shouldn’t have to schedule your day around us. Leave the bin at the curb after collection — we handle everything else and confirm once it’s done.

Rooted in Hilton. Rolling through Monroe County.

We started on our own street in Hilton and expanded route by route based on where neighbors asked us to go next. Today that covers Rochester, Greece, Spencerport, Brockport, and the surrounding towns — with new streets added most months.
